# NetLicensing fixtures

The synthetic JSON envelope expresses the Product example from https://netlicensing.io/wiki/product-services using the property-list JSON representation. It is a local parser fixture, not a claim that the page publishes this JSON verbatim. Envelope and error semantics are documented at https://netlicensing.io/wiki/api-conventions; API-key authentication is documented at https://netlicensing.io/wiki/security.
